models_evaluated: fully automated deep learning GA segmentation model trained on manual planimetry annotations

links.outcome: Share of AI-generated GA masks acceptable without human edits and free of longitudinal regression errors
links.effect: AI masks acceptable in 84.8% of visits; 81.4% of cases showed no regression over time, so about 15% needed human intervention.
links.quote: Artificial intelligence masks were deemed acceptable in 84.8% of visits, and 81.4% of cases showed no regression over time.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively compares fully automated AI segmentation of geographic atrophy against manual and semiautomated methods on clinical trial data, evaluating accuracy and need for human edits without testing a deployment intervention.
